description: This file defines a Python class 'JiraClient' that provides an asynchronous client for interacting with the Jira REST API v3. It includes configuration data structures, error classes, and methods for creating, updating, commenting on, and retrieving Jira issues, with built-in retry and backoff logic.

classes.name: JiraNotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when a Jira resource is not found.

classes.name: JiraRateLimitError
classes.description: Exception raised when Jira rate limit is exceeded.

classes.name: JiraServerError
classes.description: Exception for 5xx server responses from Jira.
